description: Nexus-70B-Instruct is a high-capability generative language model optimized for complex reasoning, multi-turn coding, and instruction following across enterprise workflows.
intended_purpose: Complex reasoning, quantitative analysis, and mathematical problem solving
Software engineering assistance and multi-language code generation
Technical document summarization and executive brief preparation
Enterprise agentic tool use and workflow orchestration
limitations: Context window limited to 128k tokens; attention quality degrades on >100k distractors
May occasionally hallucinate citations when querying real-time world events beyond knowledge cutoff
Non-English low-resource language performance is lower than high-resource benchmarks
out_of_scope_uses: Autonomous medical diagnosis or clinical prescription without certified human-in-the-loop oversight
Generation of malicious cyber-attack scripts, malware, or exploit payloads
High-frequency algorithmic trading decision making without backtesting guardrails
Automated legal sentencing, credit denial, or biometric surveillance decisions

maintenance_contact.team: Nexus Foundation AI Safety & Alignment Group

training_data_summary.composition: Curated web crawl (55%), Technical papers & textbooks (20%), Synthetic reasoning datasets (15%), High-quality source code (10%)
training_data_summary.filtering: Strict toxicity, PII redaction, deduplication, and synthetic quality scoring

ethical_considerations: Extensively red-teamed against prompt injection, jailbreaking, and hazardous chemical/biological requests
Reinforcement learning with Human & AI Feedback (RLHF/RLAIF) applied for helpfulness and safety
Carbon emissions offset verified: 120 tCO2eq neutralized via certified carbon credits
